name: XRing O3
description: Xiaomi XRing O3: 4x C1-Pro (cpu0-3), 4x C1-Premium (cpu4-7), 2x C1-Ultra (cpu8-9), no SME unit. The vendor PMU driver (xring,armv8-pmuv3) gives Linux perf 7 programmable counters plus the cycle counter; the others are reserved for the vendor DVFS driver. Measurements: data/pmu/cpu/platforms/README.md.

0x41d8b.name: C1-Pro
